Kimberly / Marissa — I pulled the exports for 2027-11 and traced the phx-staging-77 prefix to two patterns: (1) a burst of 18,432 tokens between 2027-11-03T02:10:23Z and 2027-11-03T02:12:10Z where the client_key_fingerprint matches key_id: f9b3c7 (staging), and (2) a second smaller group of 10,540 tokens on 2027-11-18 that are attributed to key_id: 7a1d2e (production).

The staging fingerprint (f9b3c7) was created by an API key that we issued in 2026 for a partner integration (PartnerX). PartnerX's connector performs prefetching for several customers and we found evidence that they re-used the staging key against VeroHealth's tenant in our routing table during a connector misconfiguration on Nov 3. We have the raw request ids and IPs in the attached CSV.

Provisional numbers: total contested = 28,972 tokens. Recommended immediate action: (a) issue a provisional credit of 18,432 tokens (for the PartnerX mis-use window) while we complete a full audit for the remaining 10,540 tokens; (b) block key_id f9b3c7 and force-rotate any keys involved; (c) provide VeroHealth with the per-request CSV and our mitigation summary.

I uploaded the full export to the drive link and attached a local CSV extract for the customer. Let me know if you want me to redact IPs before sending.

Attachment: usage_export_vero_202711.csv (CSV)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Billing Forensics Engineer

Hi Sam — thanks for your patience while we investigated. Short summary below and next steps. Full CSV exported to the secure drive link (share below).

What we found:
- Total contested usage on the Nov invoice: 28,972 tokens.
- Root cause: a PartnerX connector misconfiguration caused a staging API key (key_id f9b3c7) to be used against VeroHealth's tenant on 2027-11-03.
- Action taken: key_id f9b3c7 has been revoked and PartnerX notified.

What we are offering now:
1) Provisional credit of 18,432 tokens applied to your Dec invoice immediately (appears as CR-VERO-1218).
2) We will continue the audit on the remaining 10,540 tokens and aim to resolve within 7 business days. If those are confirmed as PartnerX-related, we will apply an additional credit and backfill VAT adjustments as required.
3) VAT treatment: we will reverse VAT on any retroactive credit for EU liability items; Marissa is copied to confirm exact reclaim mechanism.

Requested confirmation from you:
- Please confirm receipt of the attached CSV and whether you want IPs redacted before we send the full export.
- Confirm acceptance of the provisional credit so we can close the AR item.

Links & attachments:
- Per-request export (redwood drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-VERO-usage-exports
- Temporary CSV attached: usage_export_vero_202711.csv

If you prefer, we can set a short call Friday to walk through the rows.

Thanks again — we want to make this quick for your close.

Best,
